caption.scope: Two-compartment glucose distribution model from Hovorka et al. (Physiol Meas 25:905-920, 2004), extended with one contraction-mediated uptake flux. Plasma glucose Q1 receives gut absorption U_G and hepatic glucose production EGP, exchanges with peripheral Q2 through x1-driven transport and passive k12 backflow, and is cleared by F01c and renal excretion F_R. Q2 loses glucose through x2-driven disposal and the adapted Resalat flux β·E1; delayed exercise sensitivity changes the upstream EC50 of x1 and x2 rather than adding another multiplier here.
